capabilities: Annotate selected text in live preview, source mode and reading view
Reply to, resolve, edit, recolor and delete annotation threads
Show annotation cards in a right-dock sidebar that scroll with the note
Write a hidden guide at the end of annotated notes for AI agents
Annotate tables, code blocks and rendered callouts
extras: The plugin's own UI (sidebar, menus, commands, settings) is Chinese only; the README translates all labels and lists them. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. Known limitations include broken rendering when annotations overlap Markdown syntax and table annotations restricted to one cell.
motivation: The author compares fixing AI drafts to a teacher marking an essay: circle the problem, write a note in the margin, and hand the whole thing back at once, instead of copy, paste, explain, repeat for each fix.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach Word-style threaded comments to note text that live in the file itself, so review feedback cannot be handed to a reader or an AI agent without copy-pasting explanations.
